title: The Best Marathons and Half Marathons in Indonesia
seo_title: Best Marathons and Half Marathons in Indonesia, From Results Data
meta_description: Indonesia's marathons and half marathons compared from official results: field sizes, finish times, women's share and fees, with picks from Maybank Bali and Borobudur to Jakarta's halves.
dek: Official results from seven Indonesian races, about 42,500 finishers, show two marathons with fields as big as almost any in Southeast Asia, a crop of fast-growing Jakarta half marathons, and a season that runs from August to December.

sections.heading: What the Results Show
paragraphs: Run SEA holds official results for seven Indonesian races, about 42,500 finishers across the 2025 and 2026 editions [1]. Two marathons dominate. The 2026 Maybank Marathon in Bali had 3,578 marathon finishers and 5,219 in the half; the 2025 Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon had 3,603 and 3,640 [1]. Only Singapore, the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok and the Manila Marathon have larger marathon fields in our data [2].

Indonesia's marathon fields are steady rather than fast. Maybank's 2026 median finish was 5:26, with 8.1% of finishers under four hours; Borobudur's 2025 median was 5:32, with 5.9% under four [1]. Across 25 Southeast Asian marathons in our 2026 data, the median is 5:25 and 11% break four hours [2].

Half marathons are the country's most common race. Six Indonesian half marathons from 2026, with 10,489 finishers between them, had a pooled median of 2:38, and 10.3% of finishers broke two hours. That is close to the region-wide figures of 2:42 and 12% across 74 half marathons [1][2].

Women's participation varies widely by race. Women were 16% to 17% of finishers at the two big marathons, but 34.5% of Maybank's half marathon, 40% of Borobudur's 2025 half and about half of both races' 10 km fields [1]. At the Jakarta-area and Padang half marathons the share fell to between 11.5% and 21.7% [1]. The regional figure for half marathons is 29% [2].

Fees are moderate. Of the 65 Indonesian race editions on our calendar, 31 list a fee range: the typical range runs from about IDR 230,000 for the shortest distance to IDR 500,000 for the longest, and events with a marathon have a median top fee of about IDR 900,000 [3]. Borobudur lists IDR 950,000 for the marathon, IDR 850,000 for the half and IDR 650,000 for the 10 km [3].

sections.heading: When to Race: August to December
paragraphs: Of those 65 race editions, 54 (83%) fall between August and December, and November is the busiest month, with 17 races [3]. The season's two anchors sit at either end: Maybank in Bali in August and Borobudur in Central Java in November, with the Jakarta Running Festival in late October between them.
The upcoming Indonesian marathons and half marathons listed below this article update from the Run SEA calendar, so dates and fees there are current.

sections.heading: World Athletics Labels: What Is True
paragraphs: Older guides disagreed on which Indonesian race carries the country's top World Athletics label. World Athletics ranks its label road races in four tiers: Platinum, Gold, Elite and Label [4].

Maybank Indonesia says its marathon was the first running event in Indonesia to earn Elite Label status from World Athletics, in 2020 [5]. In 2026 the Jakarta Running Festival's half marathon received a Gold Label, reported as the first in Indonesia, while its marathon held the World Athletics Label [6]. So the highest label held by an Indonesian race in 2026 belongs to a half marathon in Jakarta, and neither Maybank nor Jakarta is the country's only labelled race.

sections.heading: Bali: Maybank Marathon
paragraphs: The Maybank Marathon is Indonesia's best pick for a destination marathon. The 2026 race was its 15th edition, held in Gianyar, Bali, with marathon, half marathon, 10 km and wheelchair races, and about 14,100 runners from 46 countries [7]. Details are at runsea.run/race/maybank-marathon-2026/.

Its results show a field built for finishing rather than racing: a 5:26 marathon median, a 2:40 half-marathon median with 9.1% under two hours, and women making up 49.7% of the 10 km [1]. For a first marathon abroad, that is a field you will not feel out of place in.

sections.heading: Central Java: Borobudur Marathon
paragraphs: The Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon is run in the Borobudur temple area of Magelang, Central Java, over 10 km, the half marathon and the marathon. The 2026 edition, on 15 November, marked ten years since the first race in 2017. Places are allocated by ballot, and the 2026 quota rose to 12,500 runners from 11,500 the year before [8]. The race is managed by the Kompas media group, and its site lists it as an AIMS member [9].

Its 2025 results match its reputation as a big, inclusive race. The marathon had 3,603 finishers, with a 5:32 median and 5.9% under four hours. The half had 3,640, and 40% of them were women, the highest share of any Indonesian half marathon in our data [1]. The race page is runsea.run/race/bank-jateng-borobudur-marathon-2026/.

sections.heading: Jakarta: The Labelled Festival and Fast-Growing Halves
paragraphs: The Jakarta Running Festival, based at the Gelora Bung Karno sports complex in Senayan, splits its races over a weekend, with the half marathon and the marathon on different days [3]. For its Gold Label half marathon, the organisers say World Athletics audits the route, medical services and anti-doping directly [6]. Run SEA does not yet hold its results.

Jakarta's smaller half marathons are where the quicker fields are. The Amartha 10X Run in Senayan had the fastest Indonesian half in our data in 2026: a 2:33 median, with 15.7% of 1,223 finishers under two hours [1]. Both it and the Crystalin Run Xperience are growing fast. Amartha's half-marathon field rose from 848 finishers in 2025 to 1,223, and Crystalin's, which added the distance in 2025, from 494 to 1,069 [1].

The Jakarta International Marathon in June is the city's other marathon, starting at Monas and finishing in the Gelora Bung Karno Main Stadium. It prices national and international entries separately, from IDR 375,000 up to about IDR 1.8 million [3].

sections.heading: Beyond the Big Three
paragraphs: Yogyakarta has two strong options. The Malioboro Run is a half marathon through the centre of the city past Jalan Malioboro, with 1,861 half-marathon finishers and a 2:34 median in 2026 [1]. The Mandiri Jogja Marathon offers all four distances around the Prambanan temple area [3]. The BTN UI Green Marathon held its first edition in 2026 on the Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok. It had 121 marathon finishers, with a 5:22 median, and women were just 10% of them [1].

For scenery over speed, the calendar has highland and geopark races: the Bromo Marathon at Tosari in East Java in September, the Ijen Geopark Run in Banyuwangi in August, and the Minang Geopark Run in Bukittinggi, West Sumatra, in November [3]. In Padang, the Blue Ocean Minang Run had 624 half-marathon finishers in 2026, and only 11.5% of them were women [1].

faqs.question: Which Indonesian race has the highest World Athletics label?
faqs.answer: In 2026, the Jakarta Running Festival half marathon, which received a Gold Label, reported as the first in Indonesia. The festival's marathon holds the World Athletics Label. The Maybank Marathon in Bali was the first Indonesian race to earn an Elite Label, in 2020. World Athletics ranks its labels Platinum, Gold, Elite, then Label.

faqs.question: What is the biggest marathon in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: In Run SEA's results data, Borobudur and Maybank are level. The 2025 Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon had 3,603 marathon finishers and the 2026 Maybank Marathon in Bali had 3,578. Both are among the five largest marathon fields we hold for Southeast Asia, behind Singapore, the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok and Manila.

faqs.question: When is race season in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: August to December. Of the 65 Indonesian race editions on the Run SEA calendar, 54 fall in those five months, and November is the busiest, with 17 races. The Maybank Marathon in Bali opens the season in August, and the Borobudur Marathon in Central Java closes it in mid-November.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 6 Nov 2026 from Run SEA's own results and calendar data, absorbing the best-full-marathon-races-in-indonesia and best-half-marathon-races-in-indonesia lists. Resolves the earlier contradiction ('Jakarta the only Gold Label marathon' vs 'Maybank the only Elite Label race'): Maybank's own page says it was Indonesia's first Elite Label race (2020); detikHealth (1 Oct 2026) reports the JRF 2026 half marathon received a Gold Label (first in Indonesia) and the JRF marathon the World Athletics Label. No 'only' claims are made, since the current World Athletics label calendar page could not be read (it renders client-side). Finish-time figures: data/finish-times (six 2026 races) and data/finish-times-history (Borobudur 2025; Amartha and Crystalin 2025); medians rounded to the minute, sub-4 and sub-2 shares are the percentage of finishers, female shares are among finishers with a recorded gender. Calendar counts and fee ranges: data/entities (country Indonesia, 65 editions; fees as listed, which vary by entry phase and, for JAKIM, by nationality). External sources checked 2026-11-06. Earlier 'scores' (84/100) dropped. The live upcoming-race list renders from the upcoming filter.
